 Top Loading story Govt cuts petrol and diesel prices by Rs3 per litre each
 Petrol price falls to Rs322 per litre; HSD rate unchanged at Rs355
 By: Zaheer Ali Khan 
 November 18, 2026 19 hours ago Print Email Petrol price cut by Rs3 per litre, diesel rate unchanged (File Photo) The federal government has reduced the prices of petrol and high-speed diesel (HSD) by Rs3 per litre, with the revised rates taking effect from Thursday, November 19. 
 The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA) issued an official notification confirming the reduction in petroleum prices.
 Under the revised rates, petrol will cost Rs322 per litre, while high-speed diesel will be priced at Rs355 per litre. The new prices will remain in force for November 19 under the daily petroleum pricing formula.
 Earlier, on Tuesday, the federal government had reduced the price of petrol by Rs3 per litre to Rs325, while keeping the price of high-speed diesel unchanged at Rs358 per litre.
 An official notification issued on Tuesday confirmed that the earlier revised rates would take effect from November 18.
